title: Hold excludes a task from --ready (DEC-258 (a1)), proven both ways by a test
description: DEC-258 (a1), as relayed by opum-doc at ODOC-607 (2026-11-18T22:45:04Z): hold excludes a task from --ready. Measured on dev 710e2b78 during the 2026-11-18 grooming sweep: quest task list --ready returned QCLI-547 and QCLI-554, both carrying the hold label added in PR #730 (opum-ai/quest-cli#730). So a held task is currently listed as ready, which is the opposite of the ruling. The label is the only signal: DEC-258 says a hold is a label, not a sentence, so this is a filter on the ready predicate rather than on prose. A test is required in BOTH directions, because a filter that simply emptied --ready would pass a one-way test.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A task carrying the hold label is absent from quest task list --ready, proven by a test that fails without the filter
A task without the hold label is present in quest task list --ready, proven by the same test, so a filter that empties the list cannot pass
